description: The 20 program areas in the Draft Proposed Program of the 11th National OCS Oil and Gas Leasing Program (November 2025), including the Northern, Central and Southern California Program Areas. A draft stage only: every row is `status` = draft_proposed. Built by catalog/build_erin_layers.py from 1 source layer(s).

links.title: U.S. federal government work (BOEM), public domain; the AGOL item carries the usa.gov public-domain label.
